text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Attention! The paperwork to extend Fine
Motion's study abroad
period is ready, and
the proposal for race admission is written!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! Think nothing of it! Tracen
Academy takes great pride in
making
Umamusume dreams come true. Fine
Motion is no exception!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Not to mention—you did a great deal of the work yourself! I must commend your work ethic. It is superb!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, what remains to be done is...
pivotal! Fine Motion, are you
ready?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You must obtain parental consent yourself.
Your father needs to hear
your goals from
you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
We've confirmed that both parties are
ready to begin. Now... please
allow me to
start the call.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The captain readies a screen at eye level,
and then a moment later,
we're on video.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's been too long, Father.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
Fine... I've seen your proposal, so I'll skip
directly to my primary
concern—has your
short time abroad dulled your sense of
duty to this
country?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Never. I am fully aware of my
responsibilities, and it is with nothing
but
pride that I endeavor to fulfill them. They
are precisely why I
have hesitated to make
this selfish request.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, I... I can no longer deny my
heart. Now, here at Tracen, I
wish so
strongly to run!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
...The passions of one's youth are fleeting,
but the future they distract
you from will
come regardless. Should you indulge in
those fantasies,
you'll find yourself
miserably unprepared to live without them.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
Fine... You are wise beyond your years. I
know you can see how rocky
the path that
tempts you is, so tell me—do you wish to
take it even
so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I do!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You see, Father, it's too late. I have
already run with all my heart, a
rival at my
side, and felt that burning desire to be
faster than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop... nor do I wish to. I want to
race! I want to push myself,
and see how
far my own two legs can take me!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
If you are so certain of your choice, I will
have you demonstrate your
conviction.
Show me that you are prepared,
determined... and have
potential worth
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, Fine Motion has her father's
consent to run in the next
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
One, two... One, two... Whew. I have my
work cut out for me, if I'm
going to show
Father results.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This race will draw eyes, and I have a
country to do proud... I'll prove
that I've
got what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What pressure? I'm fine! I couldn't be
happier!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I mean... I get to run!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer! I'll pull out all the stops, so
train me like there's no
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Fine Motion dedicates
herself to practicing for the
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Days go by, and then...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Whew!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Our preparations are complete. I'll
put you through, so please
standby at the
monitor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Behind the screen, Fine's father watches
his daughter's gate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
...As I understand, you are the trainer who
first noticed Fine's true
feelings towards
racing.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
You know, she's always been a clever one.
Fine accepted our family's
duty from an
early age, and has played her part
perfectly
since—without letting the girl
inside show.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text: Now, though... We'll see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
More... Keep... going! I can still go faster!
Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, that look. It's been so long, I almost
forgot... that twinkle of light
in her eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Young Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ready... Go! Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of this tryout race is Fine
Motion! Fine Motion takes
first! What an
amazing performance!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Well. I suppose I, too, should allow
myself the occasional selfish
wish. I wish
her success—not as the head of our
house... but as her
plain, simple father.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Father
text_block_list.text:
(I should have known she'd follow in her
sister's footsteps
eventually... Racing is in
their blood.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I can't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I must be dreaming! Father really gave
permission for me to race!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! And I believe this calls for a
"winner winner ramen
dinner"! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahem. If you would be so kind...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you escort me to the restaurant,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we head out to celebrate—and
finally put that Ramen
Rampage coupon
I'd been saving to use.
